I will maintain the severity but note it might be overestimated if the source is a real photo. 3) 'Perspective distortion' in keys: The geometric depth auditor did not flag catastrophic warping, but the visual waviness remains a minor structural inconsistency (Severity 1.5). The Topology Boundary Auditor found a high-confidence mask (0.9982) for the space bar, indicating no edge bleeding for the main subject, which contradicts any potential hidden fusion there. The Perceptual Quality Auditor failed (OOM), so we rely on the Router's visual inspection for global noise/blur, which appeared acceptable aside from the noted issues.
